hook: "this meal planner app is doing $300k/mo+ in revenue and you've probably never seen a single ad from them" — invisible-success intrigue.
body: The Mise case: a meal-planner app doing $300K+/mo with no visible ads — 18 UGC TikTok accounts running the SAME 43-second wordless video on repeat ('been shopping at ALDI for 8 years and NOW I FIND THIS ???', plus LIDL/UK and Kaufland/German versions). The video is a silent demo with two spoken words ('no way'). Why it works: the store name does the targeting, the visual onboarding IS the ad, wordless means any creator in any country re-shoots it in an afternoon. 18 accounts posting daily = 702 videos in 8 weeks; 3 videos carry 60% of all views.
idea: Mise's $300K/mo engine: 18 UGC accounts posting the same 43s silent demo daily (702 videos in 8 weeks) — the store name targets, the wordless demo re-shoots globally, and 3 winners carry 60% of views.
sequencing: Hook: $300K/mo, invisible ads.
The strategy: 18 UGC accounts on TikTok.
The asset: same 43s silent video on repeat ('no way').
The hooks: ALDI/LIDL/Kaufland versions quoted.
Why it works: store-name targeting + visual onboarding IS the ad + wordless global re-shoots.
The math: 702 videos in 8 weeks, 3 carry 60% of views.
The lesson: post 702, let winners emerge — don't hunt one viral video.
formatting: Case-study breakdown with quoted hook lines, a 4-bullet 'why it works' list, and a 40s video + transcript ('No way.'). Punchy short paragraphs.
why_it_works: 'You've probably never seen a single ad' creates invisible-winner intrigue. The 702-videos/3-winners math reframes virality as a numbers game, not a talent game — empowering for operators.
what_to_steal: The entire playbook for LC's dupe machine: (1) one wordless demo template re-shot across many accounts, (2) the audience self-identifier in the hook line ('wearing cheap jewelry for 5 years and NOW I FIND THIS???'), (3) volume math — post hundreds, let 3 carry the views. what_to_steal: The longevity data justifies LC's creator-ad production economics: creator ads 'pay rent' for months, so LC should over-invest in creator creative vs brand video. The ops rules transfer directly: don't rotate out month-2 spenders, give new creator ads more time, one partner per ad set for attribution.
